subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Only on the surface of something
solution:
The correct answer is **'Superficial'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• **Supercilious - **behaving or looking as though one thinks one is superior to others.
 
• **Superficial - **existing or occurring at or on the surface.
 
• **Superseding - **take the place of (a person or thing previously in authority or use); supplant.
 
• **Superlative - **of the highest quality or degree.
 
 
 
• 
 From the above meanings it is clear that **superficial** is the best word to substitute the given group of words. 
 
 
• 
 Hence,** option 2** is the correct answer.
